verdict.rationale: E2B is fundamentally an isolated cloud sandbox for running AI-generated code, with its own filesystem, processes, network, and metrics separate from any production system — exactly the isolated test environment the story describes. Docs show creating/pausing/resuming sandboxes, running code/commands, reading/writing files, and controlling network access, all confirming isolation from production data by design. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party statement contrasting sandbox vs 'production' data, and no independent audit confirming isolation guarantees beyond vendor docs.
